set.body: Initial-fixation policy (keep all / drop first / drop within X deg of the cross before the first saccade) applied identically to queries and references, as a recorded plan parameter. A structural plan.diff over RecipeInspection so the host can say 'rev 5 differs from rev 4: scales +8 deg'. Complements CR6 descriptors (id, version, units, typed bounds, defaults, allowed values, meaning).
set.title: UI-F: initial-fixation policy and plan.diff for recipe inspection
